# Tiama Nassour

> Freelance graphic designer & illustrator in South Lebanon creating brand identities, logos, packaging and illustration for clients in Lebanon, the GCC, Europe and the US. Work with me online.

Tiama Nassour is a freelance graphic designer and illustrator based in South Lebanon, working online with clients in Lebanon, the GCC, Europe and the United States. Languages: Arabic and English.

## Services
- Brand Identity & Logo Design: Logos, colour palettes, typography and brand elements that give your business a face people remember.
- Packaging Design: Boxes, jars, bottles, cups and labels that look beautiful on the shelf and tell your product’s story.
- Illustration & Character Design: Custom illustrations and characters full of personality, rooted in culture and made to be remembered.
- Posters & Social Media Design: Scroll-stopping visuals for campaigns, events, menus and social channels.
- UGC & AI-Powered Content: Fresh product visuals and UGC-style content, blending authentic storytelling with AI-enhanced imagery.
- Motion & AI Animation: Bring static designs to life with short animations, reels and brand films.
